title: Doctor Sleep
author: Stephen King
review: Had a good time with this one, not King's absolute best but think it serves as an interesting continuation of the story. King is one of the best at making long time period coming of age feel authentic and this is no exception. Had some great themes to investigate and diving even deeper into King's magic system was fun as it has implications across his multiverse of stories and this has been the most direct look into it that I've seen across his books that I've read. Also had really good thriller aspects that kept me engaged and wanting to know what would happen next.

Those old things were still painful to think about, still bright with the childish primary colors of fear and horror. He would have preferred never to think of them again, but now he had to. Because… well… Because everything that goes around comes around. Maybe it’s luck or maybe it’s fate, but either way, it comes back around.
I could use a little bit of grace right now. And a whole lot of luck.

For those in mortal extremis, it was the world that was passing on. In those gateway moments, Dan had always felt in the presence of some not-quite-seen enormity. They slept, they woke, they went somewhere. They went on. He’d had reason to believe that, even as a child.
